libraryBlockers.uiarc: The official registry has component TSX, CSS modules, arc-foundation and arc-motion-tokens, but this public source tree contains no standalone official demo composition. A registry-files loader plus CSS-module compilation and verified composition/provider are required.
libraryBlockers.react-bits: The current official license prohibits redistribution of the components themselves, including bundles. A distributable source adapter requires upstream permission.
libraryBlockers.aceternity-ui: The catalog records no official source repository. No immutable licensed source and complete demo dependency closure has been established.
libraryBlockers.origin-ui: The catalog now points to coss. The pinned upstream repository is AGPL-3.0 and the formerly referenced LICENSING.md is absent. Component-specific redistribution terms must be established before vendoring.
libraryBlockers.shadcn-svelte: These are Svelte source components backed by Bits UI. They need the Svelte compiler and actual Bits UI dependency closure plus the selected shadcn-svelte theme. Replacing them with the React shadcn recipe would not reproduce this library.
libraryBlockers.inspira-ui: Official examples are Vue SFCs under app/components/inspira/examples. The current preview compiler executes React JSX and cannot compile Vue templates or mount their lifecycle. Compile untouched SFCs with the matching @vue/compiler-sfc and Vue runtime, preserving scoped styles and Nuxt auto-import dependencies.
libraryBlockers.reka-ui: Official standalone CSS demos exist as Vue SFCs under docs/components/demo/{Component}/css/index.vue with sibling styles.css. A Vue SFC compilation and createApp/mount path is needed; rendering Radix React would be a different implementation.
libraryBlockers.melt-ui: Official components use Svelte runes/builders and Svelte templates. They require the matching Svelte compiler/client mount and demo dependency closure; React JSX cannot reproduce the original behavior.
libraryBlockers.zard-ui: The registry contains Angular components/directives and templates. Browser preview needs an Angular AOT build, dependency-injection/bootstrap context and stylesheet closure; the React renderer cannot execute Angular decorators/templates.
libraryBlockers.spartan-ui: Spartan Helm/Brain are Angular components with Angular CDK dependencies. Reproducing their demos requires Angular AOT compilation, providers and CDK overlay styles; substituting React primitives would be an approximation.
libraryBlockers.corvu: Corvu is SolidJS. Its JSX must be compiled with the Solid transform and mounted using solid-js/web, not the React transform. A separate pinned Solid runtime and unmodified official example closure are required.
libraryBlockers.starwind-ui: The official project offers Astro, React, Vue and Svelte adapters. React demo sources exist in apps/react-demo, but the catalog component docs do not choose an adapter; official runtime demo pages aggregate many components. Support should identify the selected genuine adapter and compile its runtime/styles, or use the Astro compiler for the documented Astro implementation.
libraryBlockers.webcoreui: Actual React, Svelte and Astro implementations exist. The React branch can be supported using src/components TSX plus its SCSS/style dependency closure and a verified documented composition. It must be labeled the React adapter; other framework variants are distinct builds.
libraryBlockers.morphin: Public MIT source exists with component-local aliases and registry metadata. Some catalog components have official index-demo.tsx files; Animated Expandable Card Stack has no matching source subtree at the inspected revision. Need per-item alias roots and complete theme/dependency metadata before marking each item available.
libraryBlockers.viora-ui: The catalog records the official website but no source repository. A versioned or content-hashed official registry source, redistribution license and complete demo closure have not been established; no generated replacement is acceptable.
libraryBlockers.scrollx-ui: The catalog records MIT with Commons Clause restrictions. Verify the actual component redistribution terms and source closure before bundling this library as a source preview collection.
libraryBlockers.toggle-supply: Actual examples are vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. A source/HTML demo build path can preserve them directly, but the current React-only entrypoint does not execute original HTML and scripts. Need pinned official snippet extraction and scoped cleanup, not JSX recreation.
libraryBlockers.designpass: Official catalog identifies a copy-in React library, but no source repository is recorded. A versioned or content-hashed official registry source, license and demo dependency closure have not been established.
libraryBlockers.evil-buttons: Official component modules are available under Apache-2.0, but most documented examples live in MDX or shared preview contexts rather than standalone demo modules. MorphStatusButton has a standalone exported demo in components/evil-buttons-demos.tsx; other entries need an exact official composition and global-style closure.
libraryBlockers.svelte-bits: The catalog records MIT plus Commons Clause. Source redistribution terms must be checked independently; technically this library requires the Svelte compiler and original components/CSS, not React wrappers.
libraryBlockers.canvas-ui: The catalog records MIT plus Commons Clause. Redistribution permission must be established before packaging a source preview collection; genuine canvas/shader runtimes also require canvas/WebGL capabilities and explicit asset/network failures.
libraryBlockers.gradients-sh: The catalog records the official website and free-component MIT terms, but no immutable source repository. Need the official registry payload/demo closure and preserved license before bundling; reproducing the gradient visually is not source authenticity.
